name: Veciana (Spain)
description: Red field with three yellow pales, the central one broad and edged by two black pales, and the others narrow and centred on the red spaces.
history: The flag was approved on 3 November 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4767 of 23 November 2006; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with three yellow pales, a central one 2/9 of the length with two black pales of 1/18 juxtaposed on either side, and two others of 1/18 centred on the red spaces; the colours represent the various nuclei of the municipality.
